newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF to unveil results of brokers inspection Friday.
newsitem.headline: MOF to unveil results of brokers inspection Friday.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) will brief reporters at 4.30 p.m. (0730 GMT) on Friday about the results of its inspection of two unlisted Japanese brokerage firms and its recommendations, a MOF spokesman said.
The two brokerage firms are Naito Securities Co Ltd, a Osaka-based brokerage affiliated with Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd and Ark Securities, which is based in Aichi prefecture in central Japan.
